title: Update
description: One structured change the model asks the harness to apply. Only these targets and fields exist.

id.description: goal id, tax_agenda item id, decision id, or asset key (asset: short snake_case key)

text.description: tax_agenda add: the new item; profile append: the note

set.description: goal: status active|done|paused, completed_on, target_amount, deadline, notes, funded_amount. tax_agenda: status open|done|dropped, done_on, notes. spending: monthly_core_expenses, monthly_discretionary. decision: status acted|retired|standing, note.

source_note_id.description: the inbox note this update answers

name.description: asset add: display name, e.g. 2019 pickup truck

value.description: asset: current value in dollars, as the owner stated it
